risks: RC-01 — EBIT coverage of interest has fallen to the policy floor, so every further rate step or margin slip flows straight into equity value.
RC-02 — Net debt to annualised EBITDA has moved above the policy ceiling. Deleveraging now depends on an EBITDA recovery rather than on cash generation.
RC-04 — EBIT margin has fallen below the monitoring line. With interest and tax still to be served, the group has very little room for a demand or cost shock.

RC-05 — Operating cash flow was negative in 6 of the last 6 months (6 consecutive). The proxy is EBIT + D&A - cash taxes - change in net working capital; the drain is working capital, not accounting losses.
RC-06 — DSO (average receivables basis) is 69.4 days against a policy limit of 60 days. Receivables are financing the customers.
RC-07 — The cycle widened by 43.1 days year-on-year to 104.5 days (DSO + DIO - DPO). Longer collection and higher stock more than offset slower supplier payments.
RC-08 — Cash has fallen sharply year-on-year: capex and the working-capital build are consuming the buffer that previously funded operations.
RC-09 — At the trailing 3-month net burn of 50,624 USD/month, the closing cash balance funds 5.4 months of operations (policy floor 3 months). No new financing is assumed.
RC-11 — Year-to-date EBIT is 53.3% below plan for 2024, driven by both the volume shortfall and the gross-margin miss.
recommendations: RC-01 — Re-test the covenant headroom with the financing bank before the next drawdown.
RC-02 — Re-run the debt schedule and confirm the amortisation calendar still matches plan.
RC-04 — Split the margin walk into price, mix, material and overhead before the board pack.
RC-05 — Separate the working-capital drain from the earnings drain before deciding on financing.
RC-06 — Age the receivables ledger and escalate the oldest overdue accounts.
RC-07 — Decide explicitly which lever to pull: collection, stock cover or supplier terms.
RC-08 — Model the liquidity runway under a no-new-financing assumption.
RC-09 — Agree the revolver capacity and the trigger point for drawing it.
RC-11 — Rephase discretionary opex and capex to protect the full-year profit number.
RC-03 — Quantify the price increase needed to restore the margin, then test it in the simulator.
RC-12 — Review hedged ratio and the currency of the debt stack.
RC-14 — Refresh the market series and re-test the interest sensitivity in the simulator.
